verdict.rationale: Slate documents background subagents and multi-hour sessions, but these run inside its locally installed CLI. Nothing in the evidence shows tasks being delegated to an isolated cloud environment or sandbox. Local background orchestration is a related but different feature, so it earns no credit toward a cloud-isolated delegation story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can delegate longer-running coding tasks to run in the background in an isolated cloud environment

citations.quote: While one or more agents run in the background, you can keep talking with Slate
